page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-48-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance from the c4d family. It is equipped with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system features 378.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU.

For storage-intensive operations, this instance configuration includes four local NVMe SSDs, though the exact capacity is not specified. It does not include any integrated GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density relative to the dedicated vCPU count makes this instance class highly efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of excessive compute cores. It is designed for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and enterprise workloads that benefit from local NVMe SSD storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-48-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, it features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 378.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with four local NVMe SSDs to support high-speed data access, though it lacks integrated GPU hardware. With zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, this configuration is optimized for secure, internal network deployments. The combination of high memory capacity and dedicated compute resources makes this server family well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
